title: DrChinweEgbunike-Umegbolu - Videos
description:
Dr Chinwe Umegbolu is a Law Lecturer at KU & a #judge for the British Podcast Awards & a fellow of the ABA Dispute Resolution (23).
The Award-winning EVA show simplifies the Traditional African Method of Settling Disputes /Appropriate Methods /Multi-Door Courthouse. The aim is to normalise these informal methods worldwide as the means of settling disputes via #mediation, #arbitration, collaborative law, Ombuds, RJ etc. ADR is an appropriate method to litigation. Recent research (Umegbolu 2021) depicts that ADR mediation is cheaper, faster & more flexible than #litigation. Besides that, disputes escalate more under litigation (Umegbolu 21). Do not short-change yourself; insist on #adr 
EVA has successfully interviewed several world-renowned leading experts in the legal profession & ADR from different jurisdictions like Ken Cloke,  Adeyinka Aroyewun, Kehinde Aina, Prof Bryan Clark, Prof David Larson,  Prof Susan Blake, Prof Emilia Onyema, David Hoffman & Kevin Scudder amongst others.
